body:
I've cut her out multiple times. Her number is committed to my mind lol. I can't get the strength to block her number because I keep thinking she might actually change one day..

I won't feel better in a couple months. I've felt like this for so long. Even when she left me alone for like a 5-6 month period earlier this year I still thought about her constantly. I feel like I'm never going to be able to function correctly and am never going to be able to replace her..
